description: A phone photograph cropped so that the entire header is missing -- only two result rows survived the frame. This is the realistic degradation case, and it tests the boundary of MIN_LAB_ROWS_FOR_REPORT (default 2): exactly at the threshold, so it must be ACCEPTED as a lab report, with every ReportMeta field null rather than invented. A parser that guesses a patient name out of a test name, or that refuses the whole document because the header is absent, fails this fixture.
